build_box_head: build a box head for ROI-based object detection from a detectron2 config and input shape
create_FastRCNNConvFCHead: create a FastRCNNConvFCHead with configurable conv and fc layer dimensions for box prediction
register_box_head: register a custom box head class with the ROI_BOX_HEAD_REGISTRY for detectron2
instantiate_from_config: instantiate a box head from detectron2 config using the from_config class method
get_box_head_output_shape: get the output feature shape of a box head via the output_shape property
